summary: Backend-only verification of the /api/status security removal plus regression suite against the public preview URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). GET/POST /api/status (and trailing-slash variant) now return 404 with FastAPI's {'detail':'Not Found'}, the route is gone from the OpenAPI schema, and the protected PATCH /api/contact/{id}/status is untouched. All requested regressions pass: contact creation (status 'new', persisted and visible in the authenticated leads list), 422 semantic validation (whitespace name, invalid email), PATCH status 200/422/401/404, admin login (httpOnly access+refresh cookies, /auth/me), unauthenticated leads list 401, and GET /api/reviews 200 with live aggregate (rating 4.9, review_count 21). Full suite: 49/50 passed; the single failure is the pre-existing wildcard-CORS finding already reported in iteration_4, not a regression from this change.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (also flagged in iteration_4, unchanged): backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*", so server.py sets allow_credentials=False and returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * . Cookie-based admin auth would break for any true cross-origin frontend. Replace with an explicit allowlist (https://verticalinfinity.in + deployed frontend origin).
Uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers (DeprecationWarning on every boot).

action_items: No action required for the /api/status removal — verified clean, no regressions, and no frontend caller exists (frontend only uses /api/contact/{id}/status).
Optional (carried over from iteration_4): replace CORS_ORIGINS="*" with an explicit credentialed origin allowlist if cross-origin cookie auth is needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Removal is complete and surgical: git diff shows only 30 deleted lines in backend/server.py; no leftover references to StatusCheck/StatusCheckCreate or db.status_checks, and the status_checks collection is empty (0 docs) so no orphaned data handling is needed.
Legacy lead documents created before the status field existed have no 'status' key; the Contact response model defaults it to 'new', so PATCH/list stay safe — no action needed but worth noting.
server.py is 445 lines — approaching the point where auth/contact/reviews should be split into routers.

success_rate.backend: 98% (49/50; sole failure is the pre-existing wildcard-CORS assertion)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 temporary leads (TEST_Status Removal, TEST_Patch Target) via POST /api/contact; both deleted in fixture teardown. DB verified: 0 TEST_ leads remaining; only the 2 pre-existing leads from earlier iterations remain untouched.
test_credentials: admin@verticalinfinity.in / VInfinity!2026 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — valid, login returns 200 with httpOnly cookies; bcrypt hash verified as $2b$ with unique users.email and login_attempts.identifier indexes; brute-force lockout returns 429 after 5 failures; seed_admin correctly rehashes a stale password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New file /app/backend/tests/test_status_endpoint_removal.py covers /api/status 404 (GET/POST/trailing slash/OpenAPI), contact create+persist+422 validation, PATCH status 200/422/401/404, admin login cookies, and reviews aggregate shape (keys are rating/review_count/live, NOT count). Note: /openapi.json is not reachable via the public ingress (returns the frontend HTML), so that test falls back to http://localhost:8001/openapi.json. Run the whole suite with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`; the only expected failure is TestAuthStorageAndCORS::test_configured_frontend_origin_supports_credentialed_cors due to CORS_ORIGINS="*".
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — the security fix behaves as intended. The single failing test stems from backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS="*", which forces allow_credentials=False in server.py's CORSMiddleware config; unrelated to the /api/status removal.
